chapter: Chano Pozo, Town Hall and Charlie Parker
title: Carnegie Hall, February 1949: "The Jazz Scene" concert
summary: He recalls playing Tanga at Carnegie Hall with Ellington, Parker and Lester Young; the band's soloists made poetry from one chord.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: It must have gone over very big in '49 for Norman Granz to put you on that February 11, 1949 bill, with Duke Ellington, with Neil Hefti, with Charlie Parker, with a few other well-knowns whose names escape me now. Lester Young was on that. Now, this is the time that you played "Tanga" at Carnegie Hall and it came out on that album, "The Jazz Scene". Do you recall that day?
Yeah, I have to remember one of the greatest
feeling that I had in my life; and in that particular album there were so many great artists, what I consider great artists, people with creativity, people that everyone had his style.
How did they come to select your band to play with these fellows at Carnegie Hall?

Because we had something that it was something new for the people, even for all the great jazz players. All those drummers, like Buddy Rich and, you name it, everyone. They flipped because they never heard so many .......
Your entire band was there, with Graciela, did you have any featured artists?

Well, my band, our band, they were so versatile because, not just best style because is a lot of people that had ideas and they put it together, whatever, no, no, no, no, they knew what they was doing. They were professional, so from out of two chords, one chord, they used to make thirty-two bars ideas, everyone; so you could say to the baritone player, to Johnakins, 'Okay, Johnakins, you got it', and then he used to make a poetry out of it; and Gene Johnson and Skerritt and Bobby Woodlen, and the piano players and Varona or Rene Hernandez, all those guys .....
What kind of billing did you get for that? Do you remember what kind of billing you got?
I was among the top ones.
